This directory contains anonymized test fixtures used by the Node test suite.

- `sample-utf8.eml`: simple UTF-8 single-message EML
- `sample-latin1.eml`: quoted-printable legacy-charset EML
- `sample-mailbox.mbox`: compact mbox with text, HTML, inline CID, and attachments
- `sample-medium.mbox`: slightly larger mailbox for search/index reuse checks
- `sample-enron.pst`: representative PST fixture copied from the public `pst-extractor` example corpus
